Write a complete Atlantis parameter folder

Source: R/parameter_folder.R
write_parameter_folder.Rd

Writes the input files of an Atlantis object into a folder, e.g. to build the parameter folder of the next calibration round from the previous one and the calibrated values (see apply_parameters()).

Usage

write_parameter_folder(x, dir, from = NULL, overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

x

An Atlantis object.

dir

The folder to write, created if needed.

from

A folder to copy into dir first, or NULL.

overwrite

Allow dir to hold files already?

Value

Invisibly, a data frame of the values changed, one row per value: file, key, position, old and new (as written in the files).

Details

The run and biology parameter files are written from their source file with only the values that differ from it changed, token by token: the comments, the units (e.g. tstop 365 day, which write_prm() would turn into 365 seconds), the layout and the line endings are kept. The other input files loaded (geometry, groups, initial conditions, ...) are copied. Every file keeps the name of its source.

Files that are not loaded in x, such as the physics and forcing parameter files or the forcing time series, come from from: a folder copied whole into dir first, whose files are then replaced by those of x.

See also

apply_parameters(), compare_prm() to compare two parameter files.

Examples

mod <- new_atlantis() |>
  atlantis_load_files(c(
    atlantis_examples("inputs", "tiny_run.prm"),
    atlantis_examples("inputs", "tiny_biol.prm"),
    atlantis_examples("inputs", "tiny_groups.csv")
  ))
#> Warning: 8 Unknown parameters: flagratio_warn, K_max_num_zoning, N_to_C, N_to_P,
#> flag_contam_sanity_check, external_box, trackWind, and flag_contamReprodModel
mod@biology$mum_GZS[1] <- 0.04
dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "params_v2")
write_parameter_folder(mod, dir)
#> ✔ 3 input files written to /tmp/RtmpgtpTCy/params_v2,
#> 1 value changed.
list.files(dir)
#> [1] "tiny_biol.prm"   "tiny_groups.csv" "tiny_run.prm"
